Its EEG signature shows elevated θ (+3.6 dB, sensitivity=14.1) and elevated δ (+7.7 dB, sensitivity=10.5).
The θ activity is present in 21% of each epoch (transient), with moderate eye movements (Blink 79% active) and tonic muscle tone.
This is coherent with W physiology: α elevated+relevant, EMG tonic, EOG active — all confirmed. Note: model primarily uses θ, atypical for W.
